trend_pullback.name: Trend pullback
trend_pullback.desc: In an uptrend (price > EMA50 > EMA200), buy when price dips to EMA20 and closes back above. Mirror for shorts.

donchian.name: 20-day breakout
donchian.desc: Buy a close above the 20-day high when above EMA200; sell a close below the 20-day low when below EMA200.

rsi_reversion.name: RSI(2) dip buy
rsi_reversion.desc: In a long-term uptrend, buy a sharp short-term dip (RSI(2) < 5). Mirror for shorts.

squeeze.name: Bollinger squeeze
squeeze.desc: After a very quiet period (narrow bands), trade the breakout close outside the bands.

macd.name: MACD trend cross
macd.desc: MACD crosses its signal line in the direction of the EMA200 trend.

inside_bar.name: Inside-bar breakout
inside_bar.desc: After an inside day, trade the close beyond its high/low in the trend direction.

breakout55.name: 55-day breakout (Turtle-style)
breakout55.desc: Close beyond the 55-day high/low in the EMA200 trend; wide stop, big target.

ema_cross.name: EMA20/50 trend cross
ema_cross.desc: EMA20 crosses EMA50 in the EMA200 trend; long hold to catch big trends.

bb_reversion.name: Range Bollinger reversion
bb_reversion.desc: Only in sideways markets: fade closes outside the bands with RSI extreme.

momentum.name: Momentum pullback
momentum.desc: Strong 3-month trend; enter when RSI(14) turns back through 50.
